title: Daily S1/R1 × H1 rejection — executable entry architecture

dataset.analysis_timeframe: Daily classic pivots / H1 signal / M1 BID-ASK execution
dataset.price_basis: executable BID/ASK with midpoint structural signal

windows.protected_holdout: 2026 YTD ending exclusive 2026-07-24 — reserved and unopened

hypotheses.market_question: Can rejection-candle confirmation convert the structurally meaningful Daily S1/R1 + strong H1 rejection state into positive executable countertrend expectancy after real Dukascopy BID/ASK spread?
hypotheses.null: Confirmation does not improve per-signal executable expectancy over immediate entry and/or does not produce positive executable expectancy.
hypotheses.alternative: Confirmation improves per-signal executable expectancy over immediate entry and produces positive executable expectancy under the frozen gate.
hypotheses.mechanism: If first-order Daily pivot rejection identifies a tradable reversal rather than only terminal/stall context, waiting for price to break the completed rejection candle in the reversal direction should select a positive-expectancy subset after spread.

method.primary_endpoint: confirmation per-signal executable 4H ATR-normalized return minus immediate executable 4H ATR-normalized return
method.event_definition: Daily S1/R1 core d<0.20 with directional H1 wick >=30%, observable only at completed H1 close
entry_architectures: Immediate: first active M1 next-H1 quote, long ASK / short BID
Confirmation: within four contiguous hours, long ASK reaches rejection H1 high or short BID reaches rejection H1 low; no valid trigger = zero strategy return
method.exit: fixed 240 clock minutes from executable entry; long BID exit / short ASK exit
method.overlap_rule: primary preserves parent side-specific signals; deterministic 4H same-pair/same-direction cooldown is robustness only
method.unsafe_gap_rule: each constituent clock hour must contain an active quote; endpoint must have active quote within final 10 minutes; no weekend bridging

execution.same_bar: signal candle must close before entry eligibility

promotion_gate: 95% CI lower bound of architecture difference >0
confirmation expectancy >0 with 95% CI lower bound >0
architecture difference positive in development and validation
no single pair >35% of aggregate positive normalized confirmation return

holdout.protected_window: 2026 YTD ending exclusive 2026-07-24 — reserved and unopened
holdout.prior_exposure: 2015-2025 had prior exposure in related pivot research; entry mechanics were preregistered before executable outcome inspection. 2026 YTD remains untouched.

provenance.notes: 2026 YTD explicitly reserved; stop/target optimization conditional on frozen entry promotion gate.
